description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, gaining Mairsil undying.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil undying triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Activate Mairsil using Walking Ballista's last ability by removing a +1/+1 counter, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
